title: 📨 SPN-098 Send user feedback with diagnostic context
body:
## 📨 Outcome

Members can intentionally send feedback through **Account actions → Send feedback…** or **Document actions**. Success means the report is durably stored; an ambiguous retry preserves the exact report without duplication.

**Administration → People → Feedback available** offers **Download user metrics** and **Download system metrics**. Both SQLite files come from one frozen snapshot and share the same inclusive server-receipt-time span. The user file contains every retained row attributed to that account; the system file contains every actor and unattributed system record within that span.

## 🔎 Validation candidate and scope

- Candidate: `066c5353b466f9371759aee52e47d169bc0d5e9a`; integrated main: `49c6664393c4ef9154dcb6985d078e9521b5b618`.
- Full effort-L outcome remains together. No TTL implementation, new instrumentation, feedback inbox, arbitrary query API, attachment, notification, or document authority is added.
- [Original ticket](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/49c6664393c4ef9154dcb6985d078e9521b5b618/docs/todo/SPN-098.md) · [Maintained decisions and current checkpoint](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/066c5353b466f9371759aee52e47d169bc0d5e9a/docs/implementation/SPN-098.md) · [Operator/member guide](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/066c5353b466f9371759aee52e47d169bc0d5e9a/docs/diagnostics.md#send-feedback-and-compare-its-context).
- [Machine-readable local evidence and retained raw logs](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/066c5353b466f9371759aee52e47d169bc0d5e9a/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-098-resume/summary.json). Production source is unchanged from preserved source `e6a6df1325420874b9404b79b93d9287fac18424`; the final delta adds a cleanup-denial regression and evidence.

## 🧑‍🔬 Independent review — agent review only

Both nonimplementing reviewers inspected the full original scope and source, then revalidated the same final committed candidate `066c5353b466f9371759aee52e47d169bc0d5e9a`. These are prepublication quality assessments; current hosted acceptance and independent current-image approval remain separate merge gates.

| Reviewer | Scope /35 | Correctness /25 | Regression /20 | CI/operations /10 | Maintainability/process/complexity /10 | Total |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `/root/feedback_acceptance_audit` | 35 | 25 | 18 | 9 | 10 | **97/100** |
| `/root/feedback_security_review` | 35 | 25 | 20 | 9 | 10 | **99/100** |

Product review deducts two points pending current real-app/rendered-state evidence and one for hosted/native execution. Security review reserves one point for current hosted acceptance. Both report no unresolved source-quality blocker. The startup-capacity finding and cleanup-failure coverage finding below are resolved. Neither review claims a current visual pass or authorizes merge before the outstanding checks.

## 🧪 Test plan and observed evidence

| Contract / owner | Observed local result |
| --- | --- |
| Diagnostics/context store, HTTP, worker and transfer suites | **70 tests across 11 files passed** after the capacity repair: 20,077 ms guarded; 531,968 KiB peak. |
| Additional removal-denial coverage, existing capacity suite | **3/3 passed**: one new case and two overlapping the earlier 70. 3,162 ms guarded; 429,736 KiB peak. This is not a claimed full 71-test rerun. |
| TypeScript and source/test lint/format | Passed after both repairs. Latest full typecheck plus changed-test checks: 10,102 ms; 1,985,636 KiB peak. Full initial dependencies/oxlint passed; one format issue was detected and repaired. |
| Production browser build | Passed: 7,734 ms guarded; 1,738,672 KiB peak. Subsequent changes affect server index setup/tests/evidence, not this browser bundle. |
| Backlog, exact-title PR check and evidence bookkeeping | Passed; generated index preserves all main completions and allocated IDs. |
| Local real-app browser and focused Storybook attempts | **Environment-blocked, not passes.** App startup hit abstract Unix-socket `EPERM`; Storybook stopped before building on `uv_interface_addresses` `EPERM`. The workspace prohibited escalation; neither restriction was bypassed. |

All test/build workloads used pinned Node 26.12.1, serialization and a 2-GiB process-tree watchdog. The local browser was exact pinned Chrome for Testing 156.0.8078.4. Original failed attempts, logs, measurements and source hashes are retained.

**Hosted acceptance at validation publication is outstanding.** Existing automatic routing and budgets are unchanged. The current-head **Backlog, Pull request, Lint, Typecheck, Unit tests, Lib tests and Playwright smoke** gates must pass, including their selected workers. Required development/production diagnostics flows, full Storybook/current light-dark-phone images and independent visual approval, and selected native responsiveness/callback acceptance must finish before merge. [Current checks](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/pull/227/checks). Missing, failed, cancelled or flaky acceptance is not a pass.

`e2e/diagnostics.spec.ts` retains all four ordinary development/production journeys. The paired-export case checks the first preparation response and exactly one preparation, real durable retries, exact SQLite rows/window/manifests, later ingestion, expiry and authority; its `spn098-feedback-pair.json` is retained. The truncation case checks clear/cancel/flag refresh and deliberate new submission. Shared diagnostics/auth/export and UI changes continue selecting the existing applicable native and compatibility work.

## 🛠 Findings and dispositions

- **Full-store startup growth — repaired.** A real SQLite negative control reproduced ten pages against an eight-page fixture ceiling. Removed two optional startup indexes; existing name/primary-key indexes and the bounded export worker remain. Reopen preserves generation/rows/flags, both complete artifacts, explicit clear and resumed feedback without growth.
- **Cleanup-denial recovery coverage — added.** Targeted removal failure keeps the old lease unavailable and prevents another staging allocation. Restoring removal permits cleanup and a fresh pair. Real SQLite, worker and other filesystem behavior remain intact.
- **Prior development prepare409 — retained and repaired in source.** The surviving-mount microtask guard prevents obsolete StrictMode mount work; the real browser assertion remains required. Historical failed attempts remain recorded rather than retried into a pass.
- **Prior native latency failures — retained.** SPN-135 is merged through current main. Its mitigation and causal limits remain documented; fresh feedback-source native acceptance still owns this candidate.
- **Prior visual findings — repaired in source and historically reviewed.** Long-text wrapping, stale pair controls, recovery target sizes, disclosure marker, fixture window and dismissal/focus timing retain their regressions. Fresh hosted images still need independent current-head approval.

## 👥 Integrity, privacy and bounded lifecycle

Owner and Collaborator gain durable intentional reports with exact retry intent and authorized context. Operator sees metadata-only flags and receives complete scoped files. Link guest gains no feedback or diagnostic-read permission. Automatic collection excludes document contents, titles, formulas, screenshots, secrets and raw URLs; explicitly entered feedback remains untrusted submitted text.

The server derives actor/build/receipt time and verifies current access. Session/generation binding survives restart. Explicit truncate fences old retries and invalidates unfinished pairs. Fresh output databases exclude other users' raw bytes from the user scope; both manifests preserve row counts, source/time/generation and unknown historical completeness.

One pair expires five minutes after preparation starts. Preparation and full transfer each have a 30-second deadline. Each artifact is at most 66 MiB; staging is bounded to 198 MiB plus the 256 MiB reserve. An idle pair holds no live database or general-export lock. Cancellation, expiry, access changes and truncation fence unfinished work; failed cleanup retains an unavailable lease until removal succeeds.

## 🔗 SPN-110 and completion

SPN-110 remains separately open in [PR #247](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/pull/247). Optional retention metadata and simulated-expiry tests permit either landing order. Whichever ticket integrates second must retain the [actual combined expiry/export regression](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/commit/f8c4b7461f7df5b9bc35459c0e6b5538c8161115) in its normal suite. Preserve its archive tag and active branch.

The only SPN-098 implementation branch is `codex/spn-098-feedback-diagnostics`. Existing SPN-098 failure/visual archives are evidence tags, not obsolete implementation branches. The verified candidate will be squash-merged with an expected-head guard only after all acceptance gates; branch cleanup is rechecked after GitHub confirms the merge.
